checks: hardware_identity_matches_HARDWARE-IDENTITY-STAMP.json (or this IS the first run, which creates the stamp)
sufficient_free_ram_via_argine_planner_plan_feasibility (reusing the exact fix from commit f053059)
no_concurrent_benchmark_process (exclusive lock file, same pattern as tools/r2_11_capture_driver.py and tools/r2_11_eval_runner.py)
pre_run_machine_gate.fail_closed: If ANY check fails, the run is NOT performed; the gate failure is recorded and the campaign halts for that run, never silently proceeding with a weakened condition.

per_run_record_schema: run_id (globally unique, e.g. uuid4 or a deterministic hash of workload+budget+policy+repetition+ordering_block+timestamp)
output_token_digest (sha256 of the generated token-ID sequence or text)

persistence.method: Exactly the same atomic write-then-rename pattern as tools/r2_11_eval_runner.py's atomic_write_json/cell_path, extended with an exclusive run-id check: a run record is written ONCE; a second attempt to write the same run_id must fail loudly (duplicate-run-ID prevention) rather than silently overwrite.
persistence.resumability: The campaign is resumable: on restart, any run_id whose record already exists on disk (and whose recorded configuration matches the expected cell) is skipped; only missing runs are (re-)executed.
persistence.duplicate_writer_prevention: An exclusive lock file (O_CREAT|O_EXCL), identical in spirit to tools/r2_11_eval_runner.py's acquire_lock/release_lock, held for the duration of the whole campaign process (not per-run, since the campaign is a single long-running sequential process on one machine).

cooldown_thermal_policy.if_temperature_telemetry_available: Freeze an allowed CPU temperature range (to be filled in HARDWARE-IDENTITY-STAMP.json from the host's idle baseline at first run, e.g. idle_temp_C + 15C as a conservative ceiling) and a pause-until-below-ceiling rule between paired blocks.
cooldown_thermal_policy.if_not_reliably_available: Conservative FIXED pause policy, applied uniformly regardless of any observed performance difference: 15 seconds between every paired AB/BA run, 60 seconds between every (workload,budget) cell. This exact rule is frozen now; it must NOT be changed after observing that one policy runs slower (per section 23's explicit instruction).

r2_12_runtime_opened_gate: Runtime execution (any of the 144 process launches, warmups included) must NOT begin before a SEPARATE, explicit R2_12_RUNTIME_OPENED commit exists, analogous to R2-11's R2_11_EVAL_OPENED gate. This Phase-0 freeze does not create that commit.
